messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: GPU capacity exhaustion in gcp-ap-southeast4. Autoscaler attach failures observed (attach_denied). infer-queue length: 12,400. Severity: P1. Link: https://console.internal/incidents/7187654321
Jordan (on-call): Ack — grabbing triage. Looking at autoscaler logs / cloud attach errors now.
Carla (infra): console shows error: "RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Insufficient accelerators remaining for project." Seems like project-level GPU quota hit in ap-southeast4. Confirming with gcloud.
Carla (infra): gcloud snippet: 
```
$ gcloud compute accelerators list --filter=zone:asia-southeast4
ERROR: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for project 12345 in region asia-southeast4.
```
Erin (ML): Customer impact: hosted inference error rate ~30% 503/timeouts for last 10m, median token latency up 4x. Dedicated customers on reserved capacity unaffected. Putting metrics to the incident channel.
Sam (support): Drafting customer note for affected tenants + status page blurb. Will post draft for approval in 10m.
Jordan (on-call): Immediate mitigations: 1) Route new low-priority requests to fallback regions (ap-southeast1 / us-central1) 2) Reduce concurrency per-route from 8 -> 2 to slow queue growth 3) Enable CPU fallback pool for lightweight requests. Applying routing change now.
Jordan (on-call): Command used (router control): 
```
/infra router update-policy --route infer-hosted --failover-regions=ap-southeast1,us-central1 --concurrency=2
```
Carla (infra): Opened GCP support case CASE-2026-71876, requested emergency quota bump of +200 GPUs for ap-southeast4. Case notes: attach_denied + customer impact. GCP ETA: 2-4 hours if approved.
Carla (infra): Also killed a non-critical large backfill job to free ~16 GPUs immediately: `kubectl delete job large-batch-inference --namespace=batch` — freed ~14 GPUs.
Erin (ML): Spinning up quantized 8-bit model on CPU fallback pool to accept small requests (chat-lite). Will reduce QPS to core models. Deploy command: `deploy canary chat-lite --pool=cpu-fallback --replicas=6`
Jordan (on-call): After routing + killing backfill + CPU fallback, queue length down to ~3,800 (was 12,400). Error rate dropped to ~12%. Still degraded but better.
GCP Support: Received case, we've queued for quota review. Can expedite with justification. Please paste recent error logs and customer impact metrics.
Sam (support): Pushed customer note to draft: "We're experiencing elevated errors/delays in ap-southeast4 due to cloud GPU limits. We're mitigating by routing and fallbacks; next update in 30m." Who signs off?
Jordan (on-call): I'll sign and publish to status.redwood.ai after Carla confirms no further capacity ops.
Carla (infra): Posting quick runbook refs: /runbooks/gpu-quota-attach-deny and link to autoscaler logs. Also scheduled a follow-up to request org-level quota audit.
Erin (ML): Monitoring model quality on fallback — slight increase in hallucination for chat-lite, but acceptable for non-SLA traffic. Flagging potential regression for postmortem.
Jordan (on-call): Reducing severity to P2 after partial mitigation and improved error rate. Leaving this channel open for updates. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident update posted to status page and on-call bridge.
Sam (support): Sent initial customer notes to 12 affected customers.
Carla (infra): GCP responded: asking for usage histogram and list of projects consuming GPUs. Sent immediately. GCP Support estimate still 2-3 hours if quota increase approved.
Jordan (on-call): Plan until quota resolved: keep failover routing, keep reduced concurrency, maintain CPU fallback, and avoid starting any non-critical GPU jobs. If queue remains >2k for 2h, escalate to exec on-call.
Erin (ML): Queue now 1,250 and trending down. Token latency back to ~1.5x baseline.
Jordan (on-call): Thanks team — keep monitoring. Will post final update once GCP confirms quota or when queue stabilizes under 500 for 30m.
incident-bot: Last automated update: queue=1,250, error_rate=8%, severity=P2.
